accepts.because: the question of one call of the curator beside it: `body.ask` the route stamp (`path`, `needs`, `families`) and the turn's head (call, turn, iteration, the consult it answers, the scope, the folded tools, `live` -- the handle of the running session the turn belongs to, "" without one); with `read: "errand"` the rebuild's bundle, which the lead gives back unread with the session's errand state. Answered by exactly one verdict

a note of what only the curator's window saw (`body.note`: an escalation the wall showed, an errand the model started, the end of a turn, a delta stamp): it lands in `./state`; no answer -- a delta stamp may bring the order of the early interrupt, which leaves on `in_feed`

a params-only update for one cell of this hive or of a sealed hive in it (GH #1353): `hop.subscriber` is the cell's absolute path, the body carries `params` and nothing else. The inner edges carry it to that cell by the end of the path; a cell of another path applies nothing. Answered by exactly one `params_applied` or `params_refused`. Draw it only from the operator's road

emits.because: the verdict of one `lead_ask`, with `hop.handle_ms` and the call it answers: `body.verdict` (`target`, `fallback`, `departs` with class and wait, `side` (the side calls, D58 moveout), `reason`, `escalate` and the target it fell `from`, `speak_check`, `pending`, `deny`), `body.fwd`/`body.errand`, `body.again`. The composite draws it to its curator, where it arrives on `in_lead`; the station keys of the lead (`cur_origin`, `cur_phase`, `cur_call`, `cur_reason`, the same names as the curator's) never leave the hive

an order of the lead to the curator beside it (D58 moveout, GH #1476): the early interrupt of a crisis heard on a partial -- `hop.section` `interrupt`, `hop.once` `interrupt`, `hop.sender` `lead`, the handle `live`, `session_id`, `turn_id` and the round `audience_set` in the head, the question as the assistant's text and `body.mark {delta_n}`. The composite draws it to its curator, where it arrives on the curator's lane `in_feed` (opened there by `feed_in` "1"); the curator sends it once per turn and books it. The station keys of the lead never leave the hive
the cell named by `hop.subscriber` of an `in_params` update merged it into its live params (GH #1353)
the cell named by `hop.subscriber` of an `in_params` update refused it whole: `hop.refused_subscriber` is its path, `hop.error_code` the code and the body the detail (GH #1353)

description.purpose: Scope marker of the lead hive: the switch of a composite that chooses between targets -- which way a call of its curator leaves on, to which target, whether an errand is pending -- in a code cell `./lead` with its own store `./state`. THE HIVE IS THE ADDRESS -- everything from outside is sent to the hive path and the hive hands it on.
description.use_when: Beside a curator whose composite chooses between several targets (talky: the brain, the quick voice, an errand that leaves the composite). The composite draws `./curator -> ./lead` on the two lanes in, `./lead -> ./curator` setting `in_lead` and passing `in_feed` on (the lead's orders, with the curator's `feed_in` "1"), and sets the curator's `./policy` `lead_wired` "1". A composite with one target needs none: its curate names the target (`hop.target`).
description.not_in_scope: No window, no ledger and no model call: the lead reads only what the curator hands it and its own store, and the curator's ledger and wall stay the curator's (cell boundary). It names no target by itself: every target and errand class is a knob of the composite, shipped empty.
description.contract_out: Two routes on `hop.route`, leaving through the hive path: lead_verdict, in_feed (the lead's orders to its curator).
